_comment: Milestones for the Memories gallery, in the order they're listed. Each is unlocked by SaveData.unlock_memory(id) somewhere in the code and can be replayed: "steps" are in the Conversation format (see mood_checkin.json). Snack Time topics are listed separately, from talk/unlocked_topics.

steps.say: Remember the first time you patted my head?
I was so surprised... but it felt really nice.
The first time you put me on top of a window, I was a bit scared!
Now it's one of my favourite spots.
You told me about your day for the first time.
I like knowing how you're doing. Keep telling me, okay?
Cookies, tea, and a chat with you. Our first snack time!
The first time you trusted me to remind you of something!
I take this job very seriously, you know.
The first night you let me go to bed...
I dreamt about the desktop. Weird, right?
You tucked me in when I fell asleep without a blanket.
You told me how you were really feeling.
That takes courage. I'm glad you did.
This is when I started to really like it here.
You're really nice to me, you know?
I'm always happy when you're around. Still true!
I really, really like spending time with you.
